top_signals.title: Trump Admits Diesel U.S. Export Ban Could Raise Gasoline Prices
top_signals.summary: A potential ban on U.S. diesel exports could have “a negative impact on gasoline,” U.S. President Donald Trump said late on Wednesday, although he didn’t rule out such a move from the Administration.
